# UX & Live-Data Continuity Checklist: Sidebar Section Switching with Placeholder

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of US-10 navigation, active state, placeholder and live-data continuity across sections, for the PR reviewer.
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [tasks.md](../tasks.md) · [contracts/ui-sections.md](../contracts/ui-sections.md)
**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Focus: (1) navigation, active state and placeholder UX; (2) live-data continuity across sections. Depth: Standard. Audience: PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the sections in scope listed exhaustively, with their order and labels, in one place the spec and data model agree on? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does the spec define what the main area shows when *Central en vivo* has no buses (empty state) versus a placeholder section, so the two dashed frames cannot be confused? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements documented for which console-wide elements stay visible in every section (header corridor, badge, clock, banner)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it specified whether the stale indicator inside the main area appears on placeholder sections? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases; research R4]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for the URL/hash while switching sections (changes or stays unchanged)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009; contract S3]
- [ ] CHK006 - Does the spec state that mobile/narrow-viewport sidebar behavior is out of scope, given that mobile mockups exist? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "active style" quantified with concrete values (background, text color) rather than only "white background, dark text"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "marked as the current page for assistive technology" tied to one specific marker, applied to one item only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "filling the remaining height" defined relative to a named container, so the placeholder size is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "the usual interval" / "one normal refresh interval" quantified in the spec itself? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "fleet view shows the current state" on return defined in terms of what must be observable (newest snapshot, stale marker)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the placeholder text specified character-exact, including the final period and the guillemets being excluded from the rendered string? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, US1 scenario 4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Are the placeholder visual values identical across spec FR-005, the ticket, style spec §7, the contract P2 classes and quickstart's visual review? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 - Do the section labels in the spec match the style spec §8 *Despachador* labels and the existing sidebar labels? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the branch name consistent across spec.md, plan.md, quickstart.md and the ticket? [Conflict, plan.md header vs spec.md]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are the files listed as changed consistent between plan.md's Project Structure and tasks.md (including `tests/a11y/TextNotColor.test.tsx`)? [Conflict, plan.md §Project Structure, tasks.md T003]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is SC-003 ("fleet data updates again") consistent with how it is proven (a new refresh request versus a re-rendered new snapshot)? [Conflict, Spec §SC-003, tasks.md T010]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-001 ("100 % of section switches") be objectively measured with a bounded, defined sequence of switches? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-004's visual review defined with a named reference image and an explicit list of attributes to compare? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 - Does each acceptance scenario in US1 and US2 name the observable outcomes (current item, title, main content) for both the new and the previous section? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1, §US2]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the degraded-state expectation while away (stale-while-away edge case) written with a specific observable signal for the badge and for the banner separately? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Edge Cases, tasks.md T011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for every source→target pair among the three sections, or is the general rule stated explicitly? [Coverage, Spec §US1 scenario 3, data-model.md transitions]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are keyboard activation requirements stated with the same expected outcome as a click for every section item? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the re-selection of the already active section specified, including that nothing resets or blanks? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for the *Cerrar sesión* link so it is explicitly excluded from section behavior? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are recovery requirements defined for returning to *Central en vivo* after the data source recovers while the dispatcher was away? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 - Does the spec define behavior when the data source is in `no_data` (not just stale) while a placeholder section is shown? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is behavior after a full page reload stated as a requirement or explicitly as non-required, without leaving an "acceptable but not tested" grey zone? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is rapid repeated switching (several clicks within one refresh interval) addressed in requirements for title/current-item consistency? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-001]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 - Are accessibility requirements for sidebar items (focus order, focus visibility, link semantics) referenced from style spec §10 in the spec itself? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the "text not only by color" accessibility rule addressed for the active item, given that the current item is distinguished by background/text color? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is a performance expectation for the section switch itself (perceived instant, no network) stated or explicitly not required? [Non-Functional, Gap; plan.md Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is the coverage requirement (> 80 %) specified as applying to the new frontend code, consistent with Gate 2? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 - Is the assumption that live polling continues on placeholder sections justified against the header badge and banner requirements, and recorded as intentional? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, research R3]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the dependency on the US-06 console shell (sidebar, header, banner, fleet view) stated with what must already exist? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are the deferred items (Gestor menu, real section content, line icons US-11, deep-linking) listed so reviewers can tell scope from evolution? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md §Evolution]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the Principle I claim (Turn 1 Level 1 data-integrity risk already mitigated) backed by cited stories or PRs? [Assumption, plan.md §Constitution Check]
